name: batris-project
description: BATRIS — Battery Traceability & Reliability Intelligence System for EV battery passport, health prediction, anomaly detection, safety, and lifecycle management.

paragraphs: BATRIS is a battery assessment platform that estimates battery health, detects abnormal behaviour, evaluates safety and second-life suitability, and generates a verifiable digital battery passport.

The underlying models are trained and validated using the NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset, collected at the NASA Ames Research Center, which contains repeated charge, discharge and impedance measurements from lithium-ion battery cells to capture real battery ageing and degradation patterns.
Demo Video: Watch the BATRIS Version 1 demo on YouTube
features: State of Health (SOH) estimation using XGBoost
Battery anomaly detection using Isolation Forest and engineering rules

requirements.text: Optionally create an account and log in to save and manage your battery assessments, digital passports and marketplace listings.
